title: smime-tree: implement decrypt()
description:
Decryption is a core S/MIME operation. Implement in decrypt.rs: parse EnvelopedData DER via cms crate; iterate RecipientInfos calling key.matches_recipient(); for matching recipient, unwrap the CEK; decrypt content. Return inner MIME bytes to caller. RFC texts in ~/PROJECT/MIME/standards/.

Do NOT hand-roll any of this:
- DER parsing: cms crate only
- RSA path (KeyTransRecipientInfo): key.decrypt_cek() handles it; rsa crate inside the trait impl
- ECDH path (KeyAgreeRecipientInfo, RFC 5753): p256/p384 for ECDH shared secret; x963-kdf for the ANSI X9.63 KDF step; aes-kw for AES key unwrap of the CEK
- Content decryption: aes+cbc crates for AES-CBC; aes-gcm crate for AES-GCM (RFC 5083)
- Do NOT hand-roll the KDF, key unwrap, or block cipher modes
acceptance_criteria: decrypt() recovers plaintext from OpenSSL-encrypted EnvelopedData for both RSA and ECDH recipient types
